scope: Real Workspace uniquely owns Service and 16MiB child, routes protected input/controller/software canvas -> private IPC/helper/OpenSSH/SFTP directories, source/profile invalidation, raw-byte navigation, explicit close gate and worker/reaper join. Existing isolated local cat PTY carries an SSH profile reference to verify no auth/name fallback; this is NOT a live SSH terminal pane, native window/focus/IME/clipboard or platform GUI test. 12 cases, including 1023-byte answer, rejection/cancellation, 1.5s visible wait (Workspace network timeout remains 10s), three independent navigation requests, close during auth, profile replacement, and expected endpoint-cleanup failure refusing close without recursive deletion. final=0 means SFTP parent credit, not all application allocations; process sampling includes harness/PTY. max_tick_ns is a single-run test diagnostic without presentation/native event costs, not GUI latency/performance acceptance. No transfer jobs, Windows, 30-minute idle or fair baseline claim.
